name: m4-devirt-type-prof
description: Type-hierarchy step of [retronym/scala#199](https://github.com/retronym/scala/pull/199): `TypeMap.applyFast` / `mapConserveTypes` for `TypeRef.mapOver`'s visitor calls (`map(pre)`, `args mapConserve map`), a ClassInfoType / PolyType fast path for `rawInfo.typeParams`, and a final `isTypeParameter`, against the previous tip (the `owner` fix `8d581317e6`). PMU profile (cycles, instructions) through the kperf helper with `jitRecording`, scala corpus, one fork per build: stub attribution plus `jit_diff`. Not a timing A/B.
Both builds with the release optimizer settings (`SCALA_RELEASE_OPT`); patched JDK 26 (`jdk26-integration-branch-e9e67e`), 8G heap, single-shot 4+4 ops, as `m4-int00e3bb-kperf-l1d`.

variantDescriptions.ownerfix: `8d581317e6`: steps 1 and 2 with `owner`'s fast path cut to 31 bytes
variantDescriptions.types: the Type-hierarchy prototype on top of it
